item.title: Shia LaBeouf Arrested Again in New Orleans on Battery Charge Amid Recent Comments About Mardi Gras Fight

item.title: Patrick Schwarzenegger Says New Tommy Hilfiger Campaign With Abby Champion Was Like “Stepping Into Something Real”
item.description: The ‘White Lotus’ star also tells THR that he’s “so excited” to continue his relationship with the brand.

item.title: Viola Davis Incites Inspiration During NAACP Image Awards Speech: “Our Crown Has Already Been Bought, All We Have to Do Is Wear It”
item.description: The EGOT winner was honored with the Chairman’s Award during Saturday night's awards ceremony.

item.title: Delroy Lindo Speaks Out on BAFTA Tourette’s Incident at NAACP Image Awards: “Something Negative Becoming Positive”
item.description: Taking the stage with writer-director Ryan Coogler to loud applause at the awards ceremony, Lindo offered just one of numerous callbacks to the controversy that took place the previous Sunday in London.

item.title: 2026 NAACP Image Awards: ‘Sinners’ Dominates With 13 Wins, Including Best Motion Picture
item.description: Star Michael B. Jordan won the top prize of Entertainer of the Year.

item.title: Sam Smith’s San Francisco Residency Charts New Course for the Castro
item.description: The reopening of the iconic Castro Theatre comes amidst a busy few months for San Francisco, which recently saw a number of stars in town for the Super Bowl

item.title: ‘Sinners’ Is the Big Winner at 2026 Guild of Music Supervisors Awards
item.description: The film won for best music supervision for a major budget film, while Oscar-nominated "I Lied To You" won best original song as well.

item.title: PGA Awards: Barry Diller Swipes at David Ellison, Harvey Weinstein While Introducing Honoree Jason Blum
item.description: Horror mogul Blum is being honored with the Milestone Award at the Producers Guild of America Awards on Saturday night.

item.title: PGA Awards: ‘One Battle After Another’ Takes Home Top Film Prize
item.description: 'KPop Demon Hunters,' 'The Pitt,' 'The Studio' and 'Adolescence' were also among the big winners at Saturday's Producers Guild Awards.
